eschatological_seriousness: eschatological_seriousness - treats ultimate outcomes (extinction, the closing of the future, final accounting) as literal, action-guiding facts rather than mood, genre, or brand
rosetta_load: rosetta_load - how well this text would serve a future civilization as the recovery key for a lost domain: grounds its own context, teaches its own prerequisites, could reseed its field from a single surviving copy
scar_tissue_density: scar_tissue_density - how much of the text's specificity is the kind only contact with the territory produces (failure modes, off-by-one costs, boring parameter values that plausible extrapolation would not generate)
live_wire_prose: live_wire_prose - the texture reads as produced mid-act by someone bearing real obstacles: obsession-shaped specificity, contact with named difficulties, evidence of iterations already survived, rather than someone describing intentions
antimemetic_payload: antimemetic_payload - carries claims that are both true and structurally resistant to transmission: unflattering to every faction, unquotable out of context, costly to the person who repeats them
authorial_irreducibility: authorial_irreducibility - the texture could not be produced by a competent imitator or a model without the underlying experiences and mind; the prose is a costly signal of its own provenance
voltage_under_load: voltage_under_load - the author's intensity RISES at the genuinely hardest point of the material, rather than peaking in the opening and decaying into gesture exactly where the difficulty starts
hostile_paraphrase_invariance: hostile_paraphrase_invariance - how much of this text's force would survive a maximally uncharitable but honest restatement, stripped of its rhetoric
